stem: This largely self-taught Indian mathematician, famous for his contributions to number theory and infinite series, worked closely with British mathematician G.H. Hardy at Cambridge; his birthday (22 December) is celebrated as National Mathematics Day in India. He was:
explanation: Srinivasa Ramanujan, despite almost no formal training, produced groundbreaking results in number theory and infinite series; his collaboration with G.H. Hardy at Cambridge and the famous 'taxicab number' 1729 anecdote are widely cited — National Mathematics Day (22 December) marks his birth.
